corrections.originalValue: Strongest feature: The move directly supplies the indispensable personal-ground bridge by connecting an identifiable cluster of logical attributes with the proposed transcendent mind, giving the constructive case a clear destination and substantial relevance. Principal limitation: Its elimination language compresses several controversial transitions, treating difficulties for naturalism and Platonism as though agency remains, while neither exhausting impersonal alternatives nor explaining why abstract necessity, timelessness, or causal inertness indicates personality. Live burden: The case still must distinguish grounding from explanation, show why truths must reside in a mind, and compare the strongest noncausal Platonist or fundamentalist accounts rather than merely declaring their failure. Locked score: The mixed band reflects excellent burden contact but materially overstated force, incomplete comparative warrant, partly unstable terminology, and an underdeveloped inference from logical attributes to an omnipotent personal ground.

corrections.originalValue: Strongest feature: The move places the grounding demand squarely at the center of the debate and clearly distinguishes the proposed divine ground from an ordinary contingent posit, thereby establishing a recognizable constructive route. Principal limitation: Calling God self-existing and necessary does not independently establish why that description answers an explanatory request unavailable to logical facts themselves, while the terms brute fact, necessity, and self-existence remain insufficiently differentiated. Live burden: The argument must provide a principled reason that necessary logical relations cannot be fundamental, explain what additional work divine necessity performs, and avoid granting God an exemption solely through redescriptive terminology. Locked score: The mixed band records strong relevance and a recoverable thesis alongside materially overstated necessity, limited evidential warrant, incomplete engagement with necessary-brute alternatives, and a central explanatory asymmetry that remains unsupported.
